source: TOSCA-2 src/mcp/commandCatalog.ts (npm run mcp:export); do not edit by hand

commands.name: addCatalogLayer
commands.title: Add a catalog layer to the map
commands.description: Show a TOSCA catalog layer on the user's map, with its catalog style. A vector layer comes as vector tiles and takes attribute and area filters; a raster layer is an image and takes no filters. Take providerId, workspace and layerName from search_layers (its provider_id, workspace and name). Returns the new layer's id on the map.

layerName.description: Layer name from search_layers (not the title).

time.description: Time-enabled raster layers only: ISO 8601 time or "default"; leave out for the server's default.

commands.name: addCatalogLayerGroup
commands.title: Add a catalog layer group to the map
commands.description: Show a TOSCA catalog layer group: several layers shown as one entry in the layer list. Take providerId and workspace from search_layers and the group's name.

commands.name: addOgcCollection
commands.title: Add an OGC API collection to the map
commands.description: Show a collection of an external OGC API Features service (e.g. Hamburg's) on the map, as TOSCA's data panel does. From search_sources / describe_source_item: serviceId = the source id, datasetId = the item_id (may be empty), collectionId = one of the item's collections with geojson true. The browser loads it as GeoJSON: all features when small, otherwise the features in view. The map moves to the data.

datasetId.description: Dataset id within the service; empty for a single API.

commands.name: addSensorThingsLayer
commands.title: Add a SensorThings layer to the map
commands.description: Show live sensor data of an external SensorThings service on the map; values update live where the service offers it. Take serviceId, serviceName and layerName from search_sources (its `show_on_map`) or from list_sensor_things_layers.

commands.name: listSensorThingsLayers
commands.title: List the layers of a SensorThings service
commands.description: The layers (serviceName, layerName, number of sensors) an external SensorThings service offers, for add_sensor_things_layer. The first call for a service can take a while.

commands.name: addGeoJsonLayer
commands.title: Add GeoJSON to the map
commands.description: Show small GeoJSON data (WGS84) as a new layer, e.g. a few points or one outline you computed. The layer exists only in the user's browser tab. All features must be of one geometry family (points, lines or polygons). Polygon layers can be the area of apply_geometry_filter. At most 5000 features and about 1 MB; for catalog data use add_catalog_layer.

title.description: Layer title shown in the layer list.

commands.name: openGeostory
commands.title: Run a geostory
commands.description: Open a geostory on the user's map; it replaces the current map and its layers. Take the id from list_geostories. After that the user reads the story themselves.

commands.name: removeLayer
commands.title: Remove a layer from the map
commands.description: Remove a layer from the user's map (the catalog data itself is not touched).

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setLayerVisibility
commands.title: Show or hide a layer
commands.description: Set whether a layer on the map is visible.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setLayerOpacity
commands.title: Set layer opacity
commands.description: Set the opacity of a layer on the map, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: moveLayer
commands.title: Change the layer order
commands.description: Move a layer in the layer list and drawing order; position 0 is the top of the list, drawn above the others. get_map_state lists the layers.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setLayerStyle
commands.title: Choose a layer style
commands.description: Switch a catalog layer to another of its published styles; get_map_state lists a layer's `styles` (id and title) when it has more than one.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setLayerColor
commands.title: Change a layer's colour
commands.description: Set the fill or outline colour of a layer, as a hex colour like #2a9d8f, as the colour picker in the layer list does. Not possible when the colour depends on the data (classes) or the style draws the layer in several parts; use set_layer_style then.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setLayerTime
commands.title: Choose the time of a time-enabled layer
commands.description: Show a time-enabled catalog raster layer at another time (ISO 8601, a start/end range, or "default"). A time the layer does not offer is refused with the list of its times.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: getLayerLegend
commands.title: Read a layer's legend
commands.description: The legend of a layer on the map, as TOSCA's layer panel shows it: entries with labels and colours, or the URL of a legend image.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: getMapState
commands.title: Read the map
commands.description: What the user's TOSCA map shows right now: the view (center, zoom, bounds) and every layer with its id, title, visibility, opacity and filters, including layers the user added by hand. Read it again instead of relying on an earlier answer.

commands.name: setView
commands.title: Move the map
commands.description: Fly the map to a point (WGS84), optionally turned (bearing) and tilted (pitch). Zoom 0 is the world, 12 a city, 16 a street.

zoom.description: Leave out to keep the zoom.

bearing.description: Compass direction at the top in degrees (0 = north); leave out to keep it.

pitch.description: Tilt in degrees (0 = straight down); leave out to keep it.

commands.name: fitBounds
commands.title: Fit the map to an extent
commands.description: Show a WGS84 bounding box, e.g. a district or a layer's extent.

commands.name: zoomToLayer
commands.title: Zoom to a layer
commands.description: Fit the map to the extent of a layer that is on the map.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: zoomToFeatures
commands.title: Zoom to matching features
commands.description: Fit the map to the features of a layer that match a condition, e.g. the district bezirk_name == Altona. The layer must be on the map and visible. Catalog layers are searched in the map tiles the browser has loaded; if nothing matches there, the map shows the layer's whole extent once and searches again.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

value.description: Value the attribute must equal (text compared ignoring case).

commands.name: setBasemap
commands.title: Change the basemap
commands.description: Switch the background map; get_map_state lists the `basemaps` with their ids. The layers stay.

commands.name: setTerrain
commands.title: Turn 3D terrain on or off
commands.description: Show the terrain relief in 3D, or flat. Tilt the map with set_view's pitch to see it.

commands.name: getLayerAttributes
commands.title: List a map layer's attributes
commands.description: Attributes of a layer on the map that can be used in filters, with their type ('text' or 'number'). Call it before add_attribute_filter.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: getLayerFeatures
commands.title: Read a layer's features
commands.description: The features of a layer on the map with their attributes, page by page, read from what the browser holds (nothing is downloaded). Catalog layers (vector tiles): only the features drawn in the current map view, after the layer's filters (`scope` "view"); move the map first to read another area. GeoJSON layers (drawn, buffer, added GeoJSON): all features (`scope` "all"). `total` counts the features in that scope.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: identifyAt
commands.title: What is at a point
commands.description: The features drawn at a WGS84 point of the current map view, with the attributes the click popup shows. The point must be in view; values of raster (image) layers are not read.

commands.name: getDrawnFeatures
commands.title: Read what the user drew
commands.description: What the user has drawn: the drawing in progress (not saved yet) and the saved drawings, buffers and GeoJSON layers on the map, as GeoJSON. A polygon layer among them can be the area of apply_geometry_filter.

commands.name: addAttributeFilter
commands.title: Filter a layer by attribute
commands.description: Show only the features of a map layer that match a condition, e.g. year >= 1960. Number attributes take ==, !=, >, >=, <, <=; text attributes take ==, != and in (ignoring case). Several filters on one layer are combined with `relation`. The filter also appears in TOSCA's filter panel. Works on catalog vector layers; OGC API layers use set_ogc_layer_query.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

relation.description: How this layer's attribute filters are combined; leave out to keep the current choice.

commands.name: removeAttributeFilter
commands.title: Remove an attribute filter
commands.description: Remove one filter from a map layer, identified by its attribute and operator (see get_map_state).

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setFilterRelation
commands.title: Combine a layer's filters with AND or OR
commands.description: Set whether a feature must match all of a layer's attribute filters (AND) or any of them (OR), as the AND / OR choice in TOSCA's filter panel. An area filter always applies on top.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: clearLayerFilters
commands.title: Remove all filters of a layer
commands.description: Remove every attribute and geometry filter of a layer on the map.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: applyGeometryFilter
commands.title: Filter a layer by an area
commands.description: Show only the features of a catalog vector layer that lie within an area, in the browser as TOSCA's geometry filter panel does. The area is a GeoJSON polygon layer on the map: one the user drew, or one you added with add_geo_json_layer (e.g. a 100 m buffer polygon you computed around a place). Give either `areaLayerId` (the whole layer) or `areaMatch` (only its features with attribute == value), not both. Catalog layers cannot be the area: on the map they exist only as vector tiles, which cut and simplify geometries. The map moves to the area first: only features drawn there count, so the target layer must be visible at that zoom. The target layer needs a gid or id attribute. Replaces the layer's current area filter; attribute filters stay and apply as well.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

areaLayerId.description: GeoJSON polygon layer on the map that is the area.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

value.description: Value the attribute must equal (text compared ignoring case).

areaMatch.description: Features of a GeoJSON polygon layer on the map that are the area.

commands.name: removeGeometryFilter
commands.title: Remove an area filter
commands.description: Remove the geometry filter of a layer on the map.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: setOgcLayerQuery
commands.title: Query an OGC API layer on the server
commands.description: Ask the OGC API service of a layer added with add_ogc_collection for only the features that match all conditions, and optionally only some attributes, as the layer's query panel does. Text attributes take eq, neq, contains; numbers eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte; booleans eq with "true" or "false". The browser reloads the layer with the answer.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

properties.description: Attributes to load; empty loads all.

commands.name: resetOgcLayerQuery
commands.title: Reset an OGC API layer query
commands.description: Load an OGC API layer again without conditions and with every attribute.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).

commands.name: createBuffer
commands.title: Create a buffer
commands.description: Draw a buffer of a given distance around the features of a layer whose data is in the browser (drawings, GeoJSON or OGC API layers; not catalog layers) and add it as a polygon layer, which can then be the area of apply_geometry_filter.

layerId.description: Id of a layer on the map, from get_map_state (not its title).
